description.value:
Trigger an enemy ends its movement adjacent to you

Effect The Doorway now gains +2 circumstance to hit, and also triggers against a second enemy closing the same round, at a −2 circumstance penalty

One shotgun, two doors, in the same round.

cinderfall.incomplete: Doorway upgrade: +2 to hit, triggers vs. a second enemy at −2. (Doorway dependency). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
